📡 ALGER, 4 août 2026 (Algeria Tech) – Fi: 📡 ALGIERS, Aug 4, 2026 (Algeria Tech) – True to its tradition as a corporate citizen committed to the social well-being of its human capital, the public institution Algérie Poste organized a distinction ceremony this Monday in Algiers in honor of the children of its employees who successfully passed the Middle School Brevet (BEM) and Baccalaureate exams for the 2024 session.
👩‍💼 La cérémonie, présidée par la Direct: 👩‍💼 The ceremony, chaired by the Director General of Algérie Poste, Mrs. Chiraz Bechiri, took place in an atmosphere of warmth and pride, in the presence of company executives and the families of the laureates. This initiative aims to reward the sustained efforts of the students throughout the school year and to encourage academic excellence within postal workers' families.
🎙️ Dans une allocution inspirante adress: 🎙️ In an inspiring speech addressed to the young graduates, Mrs. Chiraz Bechiri emphasized the national significance of their success: "Your excellence today is not only a personal achievement, but another building block in the Algeria of which we all dream: the Algeria of science, the Algeria of competence, and the Algeria of leadership."
🎩✨ Le programme de la journée a été rich: 🎩✨ The day's program was rich and diverse, blending solemn moments with entertainment. In addition to the presentation of certificates of merit and symbolic gifts, the laureates enjoyed a magic show and playful activities, creating memorable moments to mark this important transition to new educational levels.
🤝 À travers cette célébration, Algérie P: 🤝 Through this celebration, Algérie Poste reaffirms its commitment to supporting its employees not only in their professional framework, but also by valuing the successes of their families. This approach is part of the company's strategy to strengthen the sense of belonging and motivate workers by celebrating merit and effort.
📸 La cérémonie s'est clôturée par une ph: 📸 The ceremony concluded with a family photo bringing together the laureates and the general management, amidst the warm applause of parents, proud of the journey accomplished by their children.
